name: Ienaga Mio
source:
Heroine of the story. When she was a high school student, she got molested on bus daily by a certain someone. However, she was too scared to confirm the culprit and just easily admitted the protagonist was the molester all along when her future husband who is a lawyer with strong sense of justice called him out.

Ironically, this event was not only the fateful encounter for her and her beloved husband to get together but also the trigger of her ultimate misfortune which comes later when her life is at peak of happiness.
